From: Elena Morales <security@zenhealth.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request for recent assessment details and remediation timeline

Hi Rachel,

We observed a small burst of anomalous API usage late last week correlated to a service account tied to our integration. Our SOC team wants to review Redwood's most recent external security assessment and understand remediation actions for any findings that could impact our data flows.

Could you provide: 1) the latest penetration assessment (redacted as necessary), 2) an executive summary of findings and remediation status, and 3) the current contact in your security team for follow-up.

ZenHealth is preparing a brief internal review; given the sensitivity we'll need any detailed report under an NDA or secured access. Please let me know what you can share and the expected turnaround — this is time-sensitive for our compliance review (we have a leadership call Thursday).

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of IT Security
ZenHealth
security@zenhealth.com

Attachment: support-log-snippet.txt (log excerpt stub)

From: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <security@zenhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for recent assessment details and remediation timeline

Elena — thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear about the noisy activity. I'm looping in Marissa (Security) and Karthik (Infra) so we can coordinate scope and delivery.

Short answer: we can provide a redacted penetration assessment and an executive summary within 48 business hours. For the full unredacted report we require a signed NDA and a short access addendum (standard for high-sensitivity artifacts).

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa will confirm which findings are releasable and prepare a redacted PDF.
- We'll include an executive remediation timeline showing status for each finding (Fixed / In progress / Mitigated).
- If you can share a contact and preferred secure transfer method (SFTP, encrypted SharePoint link), we'll use that.

Also: can you confirm whether ZenHealth needs the SOC 2 mapping for any specific controls? We can attach a small control trace to link findings to SOC domains.

I will aim to send the exec summary and redacted report by Thursday morning PST.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment: request-acknowledged.txt

Elena — Marissa here from Redwood Security. Thanks for flagging — appreciate the log excerpt. Quick context: the event you saw was isolated to a single service key belonging to a sandbox integration; our telemetry shows no exfiltration or suspicious downstream behavior. Still, we'll treat this as high priority for transparency.

What I'll do now:
- Prepare a redacted penetration assessment that removes tester PII, IP addresses of third parties, and any customer-identifying sample data.
- Produce an executive summary with a short remediation status table (we'll mark any item deployed to prod as Fixed and include timestamps).
- Provide a SOC 2 control mapping for relevant controls (CC6, CC7 areas) on request.
- If ZenHealth requires the full artifact (unredacted), we'll share under our standard NDA + one-time view in our secure portal; coordinate with Rachel for legal.

ETA: Redacted PDF + exec summary by 2026-12-03 09:00 PST. After you review the redacted version we can schedule a 30-minute call to walk through specifics.

Marissa Cole
Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
